name: Stalk With The Earthmother
summary: Boarton Shadetotem asks you to make a salve from Windfury Cones found north of Thunder Bluff. He hopes it will make a blade's wounds burn with bitter force.

sections.title: A Bitter Salve
sections.body: Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff wants a venomous salve, made from cones gathered near the Harpies' nests to the north. You are to crush the Windfury Cones with a mortar and pestle, then bring him the result. He warns that the finished salve may hurt even on the skin.

faq.q: Who is asking for the salve?
faq.answer: Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff asks you to prepare a salve from Windfury Cones.

faq.q: Where do the Windfury Cones grow?
faq.answer: The Harpies north of Thunder Bluff nest in a tree that produces the toxic resin. Fallen cones lie around their nests.

faq.q: What is the salve meant to do?
faq.answer: Applied to a blade, the salve is meant to make an opponent's wounds burn and turn their blood to salt.

faq.q: Why does Boarton warn about touching it?
faq.answer: Boarton says even skin contact with the finished salve could be painful.

attribution: In-game quest text: Stalk With The Earthmother
